seed: Objects of type `marker` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [hazard,wall] show mixed outcomes: gone x2, no_change x2. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: state accumulated across earlier steps that the frame does not show. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
4x4-cell maze read from the frame: floor colour 5, every other colour blocks motion.
Block mode: A1/A2 move both colour-10 blocks y-/+4, A3 moves left x-4 and right x+4, A4 the reverse; each block moves alone if its target cell is all floor.
Clicking a colour-9 marker arms the blocks (colour 1) and makes that marker active (11); A1-A4 then steer the active marker; clicking a colour-1 player disarms.
HUD: w=3(a+1)//7 zero cells on rows 0 and 63; the action counter a is hidden and continuity-gated, fallback 0 if no bar else (7w+2)//3.
The hypothesis (marker A3 gone vs no_change) is only object renaming when the bar first appears, plus maze blocking; A5/A7 untested (treated as no-ops that tick the counter).
